jobs.title: Fullstack Developer - Senior Associate
jobs.description:
**Who we are looking for**  

We are looking for a Senior Associate – Full Stack Developer to contribute to the design and delivery of scalable, secure, and high\-performing web applications across enterprise platforms. This role is ideal for someone who is hands\-on, detail\-oriented, and passionate about building end\-to\-end solutions across frontend and backend systems. You will work closely with product, platform, and security teams to develop robust applications and follow reusable, secure\-by\-design development practices.

**Why this role is important to us**  

The team you will be joining is part of Platform Engineering, a critical function that enables scalable, reliable, and secure application development across enterprise platforms. This role contributes to improving delivery efficiency, enhancing user experience, and ensuring applications are built with consistency, quality, and performance in mind.

**What you will be responsible for**  

As a Senior Associate – Full Stack Developer, you will:  

* Design, develop, and maintain frontend and backend components of enterprise applications
* Build responsive and user\-friendly interfaces ensuring performance and usability
* Develop and integrate APIs and backend services to support application functionality
* Follow established development standards for code quality, testing, and version control
* Support CI/CD pipelines for application build, test, and deployment automation
* Work with enterprise platforms such as APIs, databases, messaging systems, and ServiceNow integrations where required
* Implement secure coding practices including authentication, authorization, and data protection
* Contribute to logging, monitoring, and performance tracking for applications
* Troubleshoot and resolve application issues, supporting root cause analysis and fixes
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams for development, testing, and release activities
* Contribute to code reviews and team knowledge sharing
**What we value**  

These skills will help you succeed in this role:  

* Strong hands\-on experience in full stack development using modern frameworks (e.g., React/Angular, Node.js/Java/.NET)
* Good understanding of frontend and backend architecture, API design, and application development practices
* Experience working with cloud platforms (AWS / Azure preferred)
* Strong programming skills in languages such as JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, Python, or .NET
* Familiarity with databases (SQL and/or NoSQL)
* Exposure to CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and release processes
* Understanding of secure coding practices and application security basics
* Familiarity with monitoring/logging tools and basic observability concepts
* Strong problem\-solving and communication skills, with ability to work in a collaborative environment
**Education \& Preferred Qualifications**  

* A Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field is required
* 5–8 years of experience in Full Stack Development or Application Engineering roles
* Relevant certifications in cloud or development technologies are preferred
**Additional requirements**  

Being flexible to work on weekends if required for release deployments

**Work Requirement**  

* Shift timing: 13:00 \- 22:00 IST
**Are you the right candidate? Yes!**


We truly believe in the power that comes from the diverse backgrounds and experiences our employees bring with them. Although each vacancy details what we are looking for, we don’t necessarily need you to fulfil all of them when applying. If you like change and innovation, seek to see the bigger picture, make data driven decisions and are a good team player, you could be a great fit.

**Why this role is important to us:**


Our technology function, Global Technology Services (GTS), is vital to State Street and is the key enabler for our business to deliver data and insights to our clients. We’re driving the company’s digital transformation and expanding business capabilities using industry best practices and advanced technologies such as cloud, artificial intelligence and robotics process automation.


We offer a collaborative environment where technology skills and innovation are valued in a global organization. We’re looking for top technical talent to join our team and deliver creative technology solutions that help us become an end\-to\-end, next\-generation financial services company.


Join us if you want to grow your technical skills, solve real problems and make your mark on our industry.

**About State Street:**

**What we do.** State Street is one of the largest custodian banks, asset managers and asset intelligence companies in the world. From technology to product innovation, we’re making our mark on the financial services industry. For more than two centuries, we’ve been helping our clients safeguard and steward the investments of millions of people. We provide investment servicing, data \& analytics, investment research \& trading and investment management to institutional clients.

**Work, Live and Grow.** We make all efforts to create a great work environment. Our benefits packages are competitive and comprehensive. Details vary by location, but you may expect generous medical care, insurance and savings plans, among other perks. You’ll have access to flexible Work Programs to help you match your needs. And our wealth of development programs and educational support will help you reach your full potential.

**Inclusion, Diversity and Social Responsibility.** We truly believe our employees’ diverse backgrounds, experiences and perspectives are a powerful contributor to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and reach their maximum potential while adding value to both our organization and our clients. We warmly welcome candidates of diverse origin, background, ability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity and personality. Another fundamental value at State Street is active enga…

Job Title: Strategic Account Manager Job Overview: The Account Manager is responsible for maintaining and growing relationships with existing enterprise\-level clients, ensuring customer satisfaction, identifying opportunities for upselling and cross\-selling, and collaborating with internal teams to meet client needs and achieve business goals. Job Responsibilities: Client Relationship Management: ● Serve as the primary point of contact for clients and address their inquiries and concerns promptly. ● Build and maintain strong relationships with assigned enterprise\-level clients. ● Understand client needs and business objectives to propose tailored solutions. Account Growth and Revenue Generation: ● Identify opportunities for upselling and cross\-selling additional products or services to existing clients. ● Develop account growth strategies to achieve revenue targets and maximize account value. ● Collaborate with internal sales and product teams to propose relevant offerings to clients. Customer Satisfaction and Retention: ● Ensure client satisfaction by regularly and visiting reviewing performance and addressing any issues or concerns. ● Work closely with clients to understand their goals and align product or service offerings accordingly. ● Develop and implement customer retention strategies to minimize client attrition. Contract and Agreement Management: ● Oversee contract renewals and negotiate terms to meet both client and company expectations. ● Ensure compliance with contract terms and agreements to maintain a strong business relationship. ● Manage contract amendments, extensions, and terminations as necessary. Upsell / Crossell and Reporting: ● Prepare accurate forecasts, upsell / cross sell. ● Provide regular updates to management on account performance and growth opportunities. ● Send out monthly reports to clients with Account ,management , Operations and business updates. Collaboration and Coordination: ● Collaborate with internal teams such as sales, operations, marketing, product development, and customer support to ensure client needs are met effectively. ● Coordinate and communicate with cross\-functional teams to address client issues and deliver high\-quality service. Market Research and Competitor Analysis: ● Stay informed about industry trends, market developments, and competitive landscape. ● Conduct research to identify potential clients and business opportunities within the market. ● Provide insights and recommendations based on market analysis to drive business growth. Customer Feedback and Improvement: ● Gather feedback from clients regarding their experiences and satisfaction with the company's products or services. ● Use client feedback to propose improvements, enhancements, or modifications to meet client expectations better. ● Advocate for necessary changes within the organization based on client input and feedback. Qualifications: ● Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or a related field (Master's preferred). ● Proven experience in account management, preferably in enterprise\-level accounts. ● Strong understanding of the industry and market trends relevant to the enterprise sector. ● Exceptional communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills. ● Demonstrated ability to meet sales targets and drive revenue growth. ● Ability to analyze data and make data\-driven decisions. ● Proficiency in using CRM software and other relevant tools. ● Excellent time management and organizational skills. ● Minimum experience 3 to 4 years in Account Management. Skills: ● Relationship\-building and client management ● Sales and negotiation ● Customer satisfaction and retention ● Communication and interpersonal skills ● Problem\-solving and strategic thinking ● Data analysis and reporting ● Collaboration and teamwork ● Knowledge of relevant industry and market trends

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Performance Marketer – D2C & Marketplace Ads
jobs.description:
**Performance Marketer – D2C \& Marketplace Ads**

BlendLife India Private Limited \| Hyderabad, Telangana \| Full\-Time

\-\-\-

ABOUT US

BlendLife is a fast\-growing Indian D2C home appliance brand — portable blenders, insulated bottles, electric choppers, coffee makers, and more. BIS certified, Made in Bharat. We sell on Amazon, Flipkart, Nykaa, Blinkit, and our own website blendlife.in.

Our ads are running. Our brand is growing. We now need someone to own the performance marketing function full\-time so our Founder can focus on scaling the business.

\-\-\-

THE ROLE

You will own BlendLife's paid marketing across Amazon, Flipkart, Meta, and other platforms. This is not a support role. You will manage budgets, run campaigns, analyse performance, and be accountable for ROAS and ACOS targets — independently.

If you've done this before at a D2C brand and you're comfortable being the person who fixes a bleeding campaign without being told to — this is your role.

\-\-\-

WHAT YOU WILL DO

\- Manage Amazon Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display campaigns daily — keyword harvesting, bid management, search term reports, campaign structuring

\- Run Meta (Facebook and Instagram) ad campaigns end to end — audience building, creative testing, scaling winners, killing losers

\- Handle Flipkart and Blinkit ad accounts — campaigns, promotions, visibility

\- Brief creatives for ad campaigns — tell the designer or tool exactly what you need and why

\- Track performance weekly — ACOS, ROAS, CTR, CVR, spend vs. revenue — and report clearly

\- Spot what's working and double down; spot what's bleeding and fix it fast

\- Work directly with the Founder on campaign strategy and growth planning

\-\-\-

WHAT WE NEED

\- 2 to 4 years of hands\-on performance marketing experience at a D2C brand (not just an agency)

\- Must have personally managed Amazon PPC — keyword research, bid optimisation, search term reports

\- Must have personally managed Meta Ads — campaign setup, audience targeting, creative testing

\- Has independently handled a monthly ad budget of ₹15 lakh or more

\- Comfortable with numbers — can read data, find the problem, and act without being told

\- Based in Hyderabad or willing to relocate

We are not looking for someone who supervised campaigns or assisted a manager. We need someone who has done the work themselves and can prove it with numbers.

\-\-\-

WHAT YOU GET

\- Work directly with the Founder — fast decisions, no bureaucracy

\- Competitive salary based on experience

\- Performance incentives tied to revenue targets

\- Real ownership — this is your function to run, not a job where you wait for instructions

\- Growing brand with strong product, BIS certification, and presence across all major platforms

\-\-\-

BlendLife India Private Limited

Pay: ₹480,000\.00 \- ₹600,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

Organizations everywhere struggle under the crushing costs and complexities of “solutions” that promise to simplify their lives. To create a better experience for their customers and employees. To help them grow. Software is a choice that can make or break a business. Create better or worse experiences. Propel or throttle growth. Business software has become a blocker instead of ways to get work done.

**There’s another option. Freshworks. With a fresh vision for how the world works.**


At Freshworks, we build uncomplicated service software that delivers exceptional customer and employee experiences. Our enterprise\-grade solutions are powerful, yet easy to use, and quick to deliver results. Our people\-first approach to AI eliminates friction, making employees more effective and organizations more productive. Over 72,000 companies, including Bridgestone, New Balance, Nucor, S\&P Global, and Sony Music, trust Freshworks’ customer experience (CX) and employee experience (EX) software to fuel customer loyalty and service efficiency. And, over 4,500 Freshworks employees make this possible, all around the world.

***Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.***

 **Job Description**  

At Freshworks, we build uncomplicated service software designed to eliminate friction and reduce business complexity. As a Senior Full Stack Engineer (IC2\), you will be a key builder turning this vision into high\-performance software—developing robust backend components and responsive frontend layers that deliver exceptional customer and employee experiences at scale.

**Impact You Can Create**

* **Eliminate Enterprise Complexity:** Demolish the crushing cost and complexity of legacy systems by writing clean, modular, and intentionally simple full\-stack code.
* **Drive Frictionless Support:** Implement people\-first AI features and optimized workflows that empower nearly 75,000 global companies to lower their cost\-to\-serve and deliver faster, more human support.
* **Build for Global Trust:** Develop and scale enterprise\-grade CX and IT solution components that handle millions of transactions flawlessly for global brands like Bridgestone, Sony Music, and New Balance.

**Roles \& Responsibilities (R\&R)**

* **Full\-Stack Execution:** Build, optimize, and maintain robust backend microservices, database schemas, and highly interactive frontend application interfaces.
* **Feature Ownership:** Take end\-to\-end ownership of product feature delivery—from initial requirement analysis and technical design to automated deployment, monitoring, and production support.
* **Code Quality \& Craftsmanship:** Write clean, highly extensible, and well\-tested code rooted in solid Object\-Oriented Programming (OOP) concepts and SOLID design principles.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Partner closely with Product Managers, UX Designers, and SRE teams to convert product requirements into high\-value platform features quickly.
* **Production Health:** Help maintain system metrics for high availability, multi\-tenant fault tolerance, security compliance, and comprehensive infrastructure observability.
* **Performance Tuning:** Proactively identify and resolve performance bottlenecks across the stack, from slow database queries to client\-side page rendering latencies.
* **Peer Collaboration:** Actively participate in constructive code reviews, share technical knowledge, and help maintain high engineering standards within the team.

 **Qualifications** **Skills**

* **Full\-Stack Competency:** Strong technical fluency across backend technologies (REST APIs, microservices, caching layers) and modern frontend development frameworks.
* **Core CS Foundations:** Strong expertise in Data Structures, Algorithms (DSA), and analyzing time/space complexity trade\-offs.
* **System Design Aptitude:** Proven capability in Low\-Level Design (LLD) and solid exposure to High\-Level Design (HLD) for scalable, fault\-tolerant systems.
* **Data Modeling:** Practical experience designing database schemas and working with distributed storage layers (RDBMS, NoSQL, or queuing systems).
* **AI Tool Fluency:** Practical experience utilizing AI\-assistive tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot) to optimize day\-to\-day coding efficiency and exploration.
* **Problem Solving \& Articulation:** Strong analytical logic with a demonstrated capability to break down complex technical problems and communicate solutions clearly.

**Qualifications**

* **Professional Timeline:** 3 to 5 years of experience building and scaling software products within fast\-paced product engineering environments.
* **Production Track Record:** A verifiable history of shipping functional SaaS features to production and supporting them through successive deployment iterations.
* **Execution Style:** A proactive self\-starter who thrives in agile teams, manages tasks effectively, and successfully balances rapid feature delivery with long\-term code health.
* **Education Baseline:** Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

 **Additional Information**  

At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business. **Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**

 **Qualifications** **Skills**

* **Computer Science Foundations:** Expert\-level grasp of Data Structures \& Algorithms (DSA), time/space complexity trade\-offs, and Object\-Oriented Design (OOD) anchored in SOLID principles.

* **Distributed Infrastructure Stack:** Solid exposure to RDBMS, NoSQL, caching strategies, microservices architecture, and distributed queuing systems.
* **Modern Web Ecosystems:** Strong understanding of frontend engineering paradigms, including component lifecycles, state management, and client\-side performance optimization.
* **Cloud \& DevOps Practice:** Hands\-on experience working with CI/CD automation pipelines, DevOps tooling, and cloud infrastructure platforms (AWS or GCP).
* **AI Tool Fluency:** Practical exposure and experience using generative AI tools to improve day\-to\-day coding efficiency and technical exploration.
* **Technical Communication:** Exceptional logical reasoning with the ability to clearly articulate complex technical thought processes and designs to both engineers and executives.

**Qualifications**

* **Professional Timeline:** 10\+ years of progressive software engineering experience building and scaling full\-stack applications in high\-growth product teams.
* **Iterative Sourcing History:** A proven track record of building complex systems from scratch and steering them through multiple scale iterations in production.
* **Pragmatic Delivery:** Skilled at balancing rapid feature delivery with long\-term code maintainability, clean documentation, and scalability.
* **Collaborative Leadership:** Experience managing technical initiatives, coordinating cross\-functional engineering loops, and mentoring other engineers.

At Amazon Advertising, we operate at the intersection of advertising and eCommerce to offer advertisers a rich array of media solutions across Amazon’s mobile and desktop websites, proprietary devices and placements including Alexa and Fire TV, Prime Video Ads, Live Sports Sponsorships, and Amazon's programmatic Demand Side Platform (DSP). We are looking for a highly motivated individual who is passionate about helping advertisers make strategic, analytically driven media and creative decisions that transform the campaign launch experience through innovative, tailored advertising services.  

  

Amazon Advertising is growing its online advertising program and is seeking an Ad Operations Associates in BLR to support our Global business. The Ad Ops Services Associate will provide world\-class customer service and support for the Amazon global advertising business. Responsibilities include the daily operations of advertising campaigns across Amazon and its subsidiaries owned and operated sites. This role will be responsible to perform certain accurate media plan creation/reviews and to handle reporting process within the tool.
  

  

Job Description:
  

In this role. the individual works under close supervision on completing the productivity and accuracy targets. Associates are required to understand different operational techniques to ensure attention to detail. Accuracy of processing is of utmost importance followed by speed. He/she should consistently deliver results that meet or exceed expectations \& understands how the business operates and suggest changes to improve the process. The associate need to be a team player and willing to share his/her knowledge. This role would report to the Operations Manager. This is a Seasonal/Short term role for a duration of 6 months from the date of joining.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

This includes, but is not limited to:
  

* Gain a thorough understanding of the business and operational area
* Process allocated work to meet and exceed daily productivity targets
* Maintain the highest standards around campaign QA, media plan creation/reviews
* QA campaigns that are trafficked to Amazon's stable of properties: Amazon, IMDb, DPreview.com, etc.
* Provide support and coverage to other advertising teams
* Provide account team with screenshots confirming creative went live
* Complete ad server and campaign audits using checklists to ensure accuracy and completeness of campaign, including go live workflows
* Provide, verify 3rd party reporting
* Uphold user experience by confirming ad units when they go live

Knowledge \& Skills/ Business Acumen
  

* Prioritization, attention to detail and multi\-tasking skills
* Comfortable in fast\-paced, multi\-tasked, high\-energy environment
* Show excellent oral and written communication skills in English with the ability to face external and internal customers in a professional and mature manner

  

About the team  

The Ad Operations team manages the campaign setup execution across Amazon's Owned and Operated properties, including Amazon.com, DSP, Amazon Devices, and IMDb.com. ------------------------

* Bachelor's degree
* Speak, write, and read fluently in English
* Experience with Microsoft Office products and applications

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in online or digital advertising

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. jobs.description:
**Description**
 Our goal is to exceed the expectations of all our customers by ensuring that their orders, no matter how large or small are delivered where and when they need them, as quickly, accurately, and cost effectively as possible. To meet this goal, Amazon is continually striving to innovate and provide best in class experience through the introduction of pioneering new products and services in the last mile space. To meet this goal, we're rapidly scaling the Delivery Service Partner (DSP) program, where we partner with a community of owner operators who run small and mid\-sized delivery businesses that provide best in class delivery experiences to our customers. Come join the team that builds the technology products that positively impact the lives of thousands of Amazon Delivery Service Partners and their drivers around the world.
   

  

 The Senior Product Manager, Tech is responsible for leading the technical product roadmap for the Last Mile Work Planning product suite that empowers DSPs to successfully plan, schedule, and manage their delivery operations. The team owns DSP capacity management and scheduling workflows on the DSP Portal, enabling DSPs to view their planned routes and meet these plans by scheduling driver shifts. The team's mission is to provide a seamless capacity planning experience for DSPs through transparent and adaptive tool sets that customize the planning process. A successful candidate will be highly analytical, resourceful, customer\-focused, team oriented, and will have an ability to work independently under time constraints to meet deadlines. The candidate will have a proven track record in taking on end\-to\-end ownership and successfully delivering technical products in a fast\-paced and dynamic business environment.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 In this role, you will be responsible for all parts of the product journey, starting with understanding customer needs through multiple feedback mechanisms. As a seasoned technical product manager, you will add structure to ambiguity by maturely driving clarity while exercising good judgement. You will build a compelling vision and roadmap and partner closely with business partners, while communicating efficiently and effectively through superb verbal/written skills.
   

  

 You will promote an innovative product process by designing scalable technical solutions to solve pain points for a rapidly growing global DSP community. Critical to your success will be partnering with technical teams by bringing crisp, clear requirements to engineers and fully engaging in technical discussions. After launching products, you will measure impact through product experimentation and data analysis. Along the way, you will anticipate and solve problems typical of a fast\-paced environment, maintain stakeholder alignment, pay attention to details, and demonstrate end\-to\-end ownership. You will balance strategic execution with the ability to roll up your sleeves to get the job done.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Delivery Service Partner Tech (DSP Tech) team creates and maintains a portfolio of DSP\-facing technology tools that help DSPs build and operate entrepreneurial logistics businesses that are the backbone of Amazon’s global delivery network. The team has hubs in Bellevue, WA, Nashville, TN, and Hyderabad, India and fosters a cohesive, collaborative culture that transcends teams and org structures. In addition to executing on team roadmaps, these traits manifest through fun activities such as our Annual DSP Tech Hackathon and Community Service Days.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
* Experience managing technical products or online services
* Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive\-level prioritization and planning


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight
* Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools

 Support The End\-to\-end Product Lifecycle For The Transversal Order Taking \& Contract Management Features Within MyCRM And Opella\+, Serving Sales Representatives, Key Account Managers, Customer Service Teams, And Trade Partners Globally

* Partner with Commercial, Trade Marketing, and Customer Service business owners to understand order\-to\-cash workflows and translate them into prioritised platform requirements and enhancements.
* Support the configuration and management of Contract Management features within MyCRM, enabling Key Account Managers to create, track, and enforce customer agreements (trade terms, promotional contracts, rebate frameworks, compliance tracking).

* Participate in UAT (User Acceptance Testing) cycles, coordinating with market teams and ensuring business sign\-off on new features, releases, and contract/order configuration.
* Support countries adoption and enablement around order taking and contract management through regular community calls.


**Integrations \& Data**
* Collaborate with technical teams to support seamless integration between MyCRM, Opella\+, and related systems (ERP, finance systems, logistics platforms, reporting and BI tools) to ensure end\-to\-end order and contract data flows.
* Help define KPIs and measurement frameworks to track Order Taking performance (order fill rate, order processing time, eB2B adoption rate, self\-service penetration) and Contract Management effectiveness (contract compliance rate, rebate accuracy, agreement coverage).
* Assist in monitoring data quality for order and contract records, flagging inconsistencies that may impact commercial reporting or financial reconciliation.

* Handle product governance for Order Taking \& Contract Management features across MyCRM and Opella\+, ensuring the product roadmap is delivered on time and aligned with commercial expectations.
* Maintain product documentation, user guides, release notes, and training materials for order and contract management capabilities.
* Liaise with commercial teams to gather field feedback, usage insights, and prioritisation inputs from Sales, Customer Service, and Key Account Management teams.
* Monitor product performance metrics and user adoption; contribute data\-driven inputs to roadmap prioritisation for MyCRM and Opella\+ features.

**Education**
 Bachelor's or Master's in Business, Information Systems, Digital Commerce, or equivalent.
   

  

**Experience**
 3–5 years as a Junior Product Owner, Business Analyst, or in a digital product/project role. Agile exposure is a plus.
   

  

**CRM \& eB2B**
 Basic knowledge of CRM and eB2B platforms. Salesforce, SAP, or similar experience is a strong advantage. Salesforce CG Cloud / B2B Commerce is a plus.
   

  

**Commercial**
 Exposure to order\-to\-cash, contract management, or trade terms in FMCG/FMCH is appreciated but not required.

 Familiarity with Scrum/SAFe, Jira, and Confluence; comfort with KPI tracking and reporting tools.

* Proactive and autonomous — able to manage multiple priorities in a global, matrixed organization.

**About Finkraft.ai**
 Finkraft.ai is a B2B SaaS company that enables enterprises to maximise GST claims on travel and expense data. The platform automates invoice collection, validation, and reconciliation across airlines and hotels — helping finance teams at McKinsey, BCG, Capgemini, Abbott, and 1,250\+ enterprises improve compliance, visibility, and cash recovery. We've recovered ₹300Cr\+ in GST claims and are scaling from $1\.5M to $10M ARR in 18 months.
   

  

 The GST suite is Finkraft's core product and the primary reason 1,250\+ enterprises trust us. This PM owns it.
   

  

**THE PROBLEM YOU ARE SOLVING**
 A large enterprise has hundreds of GSTINs across entities. Their GSTR\-2A shows invoices that don't match their purchase register. Their GSTR\-2B locks on the 14th and there are amendments they didn't catch. Their ITC is partially reversed because a vendor filed late. A notice has arrived and nobody in the finance team can reconstruct the audit trail fast enough.
   

  

 This is not a hypothetical. This is Tuesday for Finkraft's customers.
   

  

 Your job is to be the deepest GST domain expert in the building — deeper than the sales team, deeper than the BAs, deeper than the engineers — and translate that expertise into a product that makes these problems systematic to solve rather than heroic to manage.
   

  

**What You Will Own In 90 Days**
* GST knowledge base v1 live: AI\-powered, queryable, covering all GSTR return types, ITC matching logic, e\-invoicing flows, IMS workflows, and key CBIC circulars from the last 3 years — used by Sales and BA teams daily, not just available.
* Cygnet and GSP/ASP integration map completed: every current integration documented at schema and API level, gaps identified, and a prioritised integration roadmap delivered to engineering.
* Reconciliation accuracy benchmark set: current ITC match rate, mismatch categories, and automation coverage measured — baseline established, improvement targets agreed with leadership.


**Key Responsibilities**
 GST Product Roadmap Ownership
   

  

* Own the end\-to\-end product roadmap for GST reconciliation, IMS, audit support, and litigation workflows
* Prioritise features based on enterprise client pain, regulatory change impact, and competitive gaps — not internal assumptions or loudest\-customer logic
* Present roadmap to leadership, Sales, and enterprise clients at QBRs; defend prioritisation with data and customer evidence
* Track delivery against roadmap commitments; own the variance between what was promised and what shipped


 GSP/ASP Integration — Cygnet and Beyond
   

  

* Own the product relationship with Cygnet and other GSP/ASP partners: integration architecture decisions, API schema alignment, edge case resolution, and escalation handling
* Maintain detailed integration documentation at schema level — field mapping, error handling, retry logic, and reconciliation of discrepancies between partner data and GSTN portal data
* Identify gaps in current GSP integrations that cause downstream reconciliation failures; define fixes and prioritise with engineering
* Evaluate additional GSP/ASP integration opportunities: IRIS, ClearTax, Masters India — build vs. partner decision with commercial and technical inputs


 Reconciliation Domain Leadership
   

  

* Set and own the reconciliation accuracy standard: ITC match rate, mismatch categorisation, auto\-resolution rate, and manual intervention rate — measured monthly, improving quarterly
* Define edge case handling for every known reconciliation scenario: GSTR\-2A vs. 2B discrepancies, amended invoices, credit notes, ITC reversals, late vendor filings, GSTIN mismatches, cancelled invoices, and partial payments
* Partner with engineering to ensure reconciliation logic is documented, tested, and auditable — every decision traceable
* Be the escalation point when a customer's reconciliation output is wrong: you investigate, you explain, you fix


 E\-Invoicing Product Ownership
   

  

* Own the product surface for e\-invoicing: IRN generation flows, IRP connectivity, e\-way bill linkage, and B2B mandate compliance
* Track CBIC threshold changes and mandate expansions; update product ahead of compliance deadlines — not reactively
* Handle edge cases in e\-invoicing: cancellation within 24 hours, amendment flows, multi\-GSTIN IRN management, and bulk generation for high\-volume clients
* Ensure e\-invoicing data feeds correctly into reconciliation flows — no orphaned IRNs, no unmatched GSTR\-1 entries


 AI\-Powered GST Knowledge Base
   

  

* Build and own a central, AI\-powered knowledge base covering: all GSTR return types and filing logic, ITC matching and reversal rules, IMS workflow mechanics, e\-invoicing standards, CBIC circulars and GSTN advisories, audit and litigation response frameworks, and customer\-reported edge cases and their resolutions
* The knowledge base must be queryable by Sales and BA teams in real time — not a document library, a working tool
* Update the knowledge base within 48 hours of any CBIC circular, GSTN advisory, or significant customer edge case resolution
* Use LLMs actively in knowledge base architecture: RAG\-based retrieval, prompt templates for common GST queries, automated circular summarisation


 Market and Regulatory Intelligence
   

  

* Maintain a live tracker of GSTN portal changes, CBIC regulatory updates, and GST Council decisions — reviewed weekly, fed into roadmap prioritisation monthly
* Monitor competitor product releases and feature changes: ClearTax, IRIS GST, Zoho Books GST, TallyPrime, KDK Spectrum, Cleartax ARC — what they're shipping, what gaps remain, where Finkraft has an edge
* Bring external intelligence into product decisions with evidence: not "competitors are doing X" but "ClearTax shipped X in March, here's what it does,…

 If you want to build, develop, and see your impact, join Skillz and level up your Career!
   

  

 Skillz, the first publicly\-traded mobile eSports platform that host billions of casual mobile gaming tournaments for millions of players worldwide, is revolutionizing the gaming industry.  Our product development team sets the vision for the growing suite of Skillz products. **Responsibilities**
* 3\-5 years of experience in product management, game design, management consulting, quantitative analysis, or similar field
* You are able to approach complex problems and convert them into simple and elegant solutions
* Experience performing data analysis and using A/B testing processes to inform decisions
* Strong communication skills and comfortable liaising between technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Excellent project management, interpersonal and organizational skills, with the ability to drive and implement ideas in a changing environment
* Able to collate idea streams from across all stakeholders to drive future product roadmap


**What We Are Looking For**
* Someone who can work with a cross\-functional team of designers and engineers to evolve the world's first mobile Esports platform
* Create wireframes, write specs A/B test, optimize feature performance, gather requirements and plan product rollout to deliver the next generation of mobile gaming
* Build tools that empower our business team to drive towards their objections and grow our Skillz platform
* Collaborate with great teammates with a passion for gaming

jobs.title: Process Knowledge & Agentic AI Enablement - Assistant Vice President
jobs.description:
**Role Summary**


The role is responsible for supporting the development and maintenance of standardised, structured process knowledge that enables AI\-driven automation and agent\-based workflows across Global Delivery, within the Agentic AI Program.


The role focuses on converting Agent Operating Procedures (AOPs) into consistent, reusable knowledge assets that can be integrated into Knowledge Graphs and automation platforms.


The individual will work as part of a broader team, collaborating with business, product, and technology stakeholders to ensure AOP knowledge is accurate, scalable, and fit for use in automation and AI\-driven processes. The role operates within the four\-step knowledge\-led AOP creation methodology (LLM\-generated best\-practice draft SME enrichment consolidation \& iteration governance \& sign\-off) that underpins the Agentic AI Program.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. AOP Standardisation and Knowledge Structuring**

* Support the application of standard methodologies for AOP design and documentation
* Convert AOPs into structured formats aligned to defined templates and standards, capturing actions, decision criteria, data checks, and resolution options
* Maintain AOP repositories, ensuring consistency, accuracy, and completeness
* Identify opportunities for process simplification and alignment to standards

**2\. Knowledge Graph and Automation Enablement**

* Assist in translating AOPs into formats suitable for reuse within knowledge graph and automation solutions
* Work with engineering and AI teams to ensure AOP knowledge is aligned to system requirements
* Support integration of AOP knowledge into automation and agent\-based workflows
* Support execution of LLM\-generated AOP drafts in collaboration with LLM \& Prompt Specialists

**3\. SME Collaboration and Knowledge Capture**

* Partner with subject matter experts (SMEs) to capture and document process knowledge
* Support the consolidation of knowledge across functions into structured, reusable formats
* Ensure alignment of AOP content with established definitions and process logic
* Capture institutional knowledge (client nuances, system quirks, edge cases) within AOP documentation

**4\. Governance, Quality and Control**

* Apply defined quality standards and review processes for AOP documentation
* Support governance activities including version control, updates, and repository management
* Ensure AOPs reflect required control points and process steps
* Maintain documentation in line with audit and compliance expectations
* Maintain version control and audit trails for AOP approvals

**5\. Delivery and Continuous Improvement**

* Support delivery of AOP knowledge assets required for automation and AI initiatives within the Agentic AI Program
* Contribute to reducing process duplication and inconsistent documentation
* Identify and escalate opportunities to improve process standardisation and efficiency

**6\. Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Work closely with Product Owners, SMEs, and technology teams
* Support alignment of AOP documentation to business needs and project timelines
* Communicate updates and progress in a clear and structured manner
* Support adoption of AOP standards across teams

**Qualifications and Experience**

**Required**

* Experience in process documentation, operations, or transformation roles within a large organisation
* Familiarity with AOP/SOP development, process mapping, or operational procedures
* Understanding of structured documentation and standardisation approaches
* Experience working with cross\-functional stakeholders
* Strong written communication and attention to detail

**Preferred**

* Exposure to automation, AI, or process optimisation initiatives
* Understanding of knowledge management tools or structured data concepts
* Familiarity with Knowledge Graphs, large language models (LLMs), or agent\-based systems
* Experience in financial services operations (e.g. Fund Accounting, Custody, Transfer Agency, Middle Office)

**Skills and Competencies**

* Process documentation and organisation
* Attention to detail and quality orientation
* Structured thinking and problem solving
* Stakeholder communication and collaboration
* Ability to work within defined frameworks and standards

**Leadership and Behavioural Expectations**

* Demonstrates accountability for assigned deliverables
* Works effectively within a team\-based delivery model
* Proactively identifies improvement opportunities and escalates where appropriate
* Adapts to evolving priorities within transformation initiatives
* Builds effective working relationships across teams

**Impact**


This role contributes to:

* Building a consistent and structured AOP knowledge base
* Supporting delivery of automation and AI\-enabled solutions within the Agentic AI Program
* Improving process consistency and documentation quality
* Enabling scalable operations through standardised process knowledge


The AVP\-level AOP Knowledge role plays a key execution role in capturing, structuring, and maintaining the process knowledge assets that fuel agent\-ready process graphs and underpin AI\-driven operations across Global Delivery.

**About State Street**
======================


Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.


We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work\-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.


As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we consider all qualified applicants for all positions without r…

jobs.description:
**Dyson IT**
 At Dyson, we demand the highest performance standards from the technologies we engineer. Our people expect the same from the technology that supports them.
   

  

 Global IT plays a critical role in enabling Dyson’s engineering teams to deliver world class innovation through scalable, reliable, and forward\-thinking digital platforms.
   

  

**Our RDD IT Team**
 The RDD IT function has end\-to\-end accountability for the design, delivery, and support of the systems that enable Dyson’s global research, engineering, and product development communities.
   

  

**This Includes**
* Engineering platforms such as PLM (Teamcenter), CAE, simulation, and digital engineering tooling
* Global product development systems and processes
* Delivery of transformation initiatives and operational IT services across multiple global sites


**The Role**
 The Technical Product Manager – PLM is responsible for defining, owning, and evolving technical products within the RDD IT landscape, with a particular focus on the Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) stack.
   

  

 Operating within the RDD IT function, this role ensures that PLM product roadmaps are aligned to engineering needs and business priorities, translating complex requirements into structured plans for delivery. You will act as a key interface between engineering stakeholders, solution architects, and delivery teams, ensuring that solutions are robust, scalable, and aligned to industry best practices.
   

  

 You will work closely with internal teams and external partners to oversee the quality of delivery, drive continuous improvement across product and application lifecycles, and contribute to the long\-term evolution of Dyson’s engineering technology landscape.
   

  

**Principal Accountabilities**
 Product Strategy \& Roadmap
   

  

* Create and maintain an IT product development roadmap for PLM (Teamcenter) capabilities
* Ensure roadmaps reflect technical thought leadership and industry best practices
* Align product direction to engineering requirements and business priorities
* Continuously review and refine roadmap based on stakeholder input and delivery outcomes


 Stakeholder Management \& Business Partnership
   

  

* Act as an ambassador for Global IT across RDD and NPI stakeholder groups
* Engage with senior RDD stakeholders, engineers, solution architects, and business process owners
* Build strong working relationships across delivery, support, and engineering teams
* Ensure alignment between stakeholder needs and product direction


 Delivery Oversight \& Quality Assurance
   

  

* Work within the RDD IT delivery function to oversee quality of technical delivery
* Ensure solutions comply with defined standards, policies, and architectural direction
* Collaborate with delivery teams and external partners to ensure successful execution
* Support resolution of delivery challenges and ensure continuous improvement


 Platform Ownership \& Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Take joint accountability for the robustness and maturity of PLM platforms
* Support and improve product management and application delivery practices
* Identify opportunities to enhance system capabilities and user experience
* Drive continuous improvement across product lifecycle and service delivery


 Vendor \& Partner Management
   

  

* Work with external strategic partners to bring industry insight and best practice
* Collaborate with Legal and Procurement to maximise value from third\-party engagements
* Support development of long\-term platform capability and vendor strategy


 Technology Strategy \& Innovation
   

  

* Support architecture teams and strategic partners in shaping future platform direction
* Contribute to adoption of new technologies and industry trends within RDD IT
* Identify opportunities to improve capability through innovation and tooling evolution


 Professional Development
   

  

* Own and drive personal and professional development in line with Dyson frameworks
* Use internal development tools to assess capability and define growth objectives
* Continuously build technical and stakeholder management expertise


**Person Specification / Core Competencies**
 You must possess strong technical product management capability, with the ability to bridge engineering needs and IT delivery. You will demonstrate strong organisational skills, stakeholder engagement, and the ability to manage complexity in a fast\-paced engineering environment.
   

  

 Core Competencies
   

  

* Strong product management capability within technical or engineering environments
* Ability to translate complex requirements into structured product roadmaps
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
* Ability to prioritise and manage competing demands at pace
* Strong organisational and delivery focus


**Essential**
* Experience managing technical products within engineering or R\&D environments
* Strong experience with PLM platforms, particularly Siemens Teamcenter
* Experience managing change and enhancement within large\-scale engineering systems
* Experience working across delivery teams, architects, and business stakeholders
* Experience contributing to technical strategy and product direction


 Desirable
   

  

* Experience working within global, matrixed organisations
* Experience collaborating with external partners and vendors
* Exposure to engineering toolchains including simulation, CAE, or software development platforms

Role Overview
   

  

 Data Product Managers determine and oversee delivery of the strategy and roadmap for data\-driven assets, products and solutions to achieve business outcomes and financial objectives. Their responsibilities include collaborating with technical and functional stakeholders to set priorities, managing delivery and operations, and providing direction and oversight to delivery teams. This role demands strong analytical mindset, bias for action and passion for building impactful data products in a dynamic environment.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Develop a deep understanding of business goals and processes to inform delivery priorities and recommendations for improvements.
* Develop strong relationships and regularly communicate with business stakeholders to shape requirements and prioritize needs. Translating business requirements into actionable product and technical features.
* Define and execute product roadmaps that drive measurable business outcomes, including planning resource allocation and team skill requirements.
* Work closely with technical teams to ensure timely delivery of high\-quality data products and solutions, resolving obstacles and trade\-offs as required.
* Communicate delivery progress and results to stakeholders, focusing on how data and AI solutions meet their business goals.
* Advocate for best practices in AI/ML, data management, data governance, and user experience into data products and solutions.
* Monitor performance and reliability of data products, coordinating with Data Operations to resolve outages, bugs, and performance issues.
* Define and monitor post\-launch metrics, performance and user adoption, iterating on solutions to maximize sustained business impact.
* Drive change management, including training and supporting end users as AI workflows and analytics are integrated into their daily operations.
* Ensure alignment and adherence to corporate, financial and IT standards (e.g., architecture, privacy, compliance, security).
* Continuously track and evaluate emerging data/AI technology, industry trends, and best practices to drive innovation and inform product execution.


 Competencies
   

  

* Proficient with Agile methodologies and tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence). Experience writing clear product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria with the help of AI.
* Skilled in prioritizing features and managing backlogs based on business value and technical dependencies. Demonstrated effective collaboration with cross\-functional teams (engineering, analytics, business, etc.).
* Strong understanding of data platforms, data modelling and analytics/reporting tools.
* Good understanding of AI architecture, evaluation testing and context engineering.
* Demonstrated ability to synthesize complex technical specifications into clear, actionable insights for non\-technical stakeholders across both written and verbal communication.
* Demonstrated strong business acumen and partnership with senior stakeholders. Building buy\-in, influencing stakeholders and keeping diverse teams aligned.
* Excellent problem\-solving, critical\-thinking, and organizational skills. Ability to thrive in ambiguous, fast\-paced environments.

jobs.description:
**SENIOR BUSINESS ANALYST — DATA \& CLIENT INTELLIGENCE \| FINKRAFT.AI**
 Location: Bengaluru, HSR \| Full\-time \| Level: L4 \| Reports to: BU Head
   

  

**About Finkraft.ai**
 Finkraft.ai is a B2B SaaS company that enables enterprises to maximise GST claims on travel and expense data. The platform automates invoice collection, validation, and reconciliation across airlines and hotels — helping finance teams at McKinsey, BCG, Capgemini, Abbott, and 1,250\+ enterprises improve compliance, visibility, and cash recovery. We've recovered ₹300Cr\+ in GST claims and are scaling from $1\.5M to $10M ARR in 18 months.
   

  

**THE OPERATING PHILOSOPHY OF THIS ROLE**
 AI\-first is not a preference here. It is the baseline. Every analysis, every BRD, every QBR deck, every RCA, and every insight you produce starts with AI augmentation. If you are doing something manually that an AI agent could do faster and better, that is a process failure, not a workstyle choice.
   

  

 This role exists because Finkraft's enterprise clients generate more data, more edge cases, and more expansion signals than any team can process without AI. You are the person who builds the system that processes it.
   

  

**What You Will Own In 90 Days**
* AI\-augmented analysis pipeline live: at least 3 recurring workflows (QBR prep, RCA, client health scoring) running through AI tools — output quality higher, turnaround time lower than manual baseline.
* Team operating cadence set: weekly 1:1s and team standups running for both data BAs and field BAs, with structured output templates and quality bar defined.
* Customisation pipeline tracked: live dashboard showing open customisation requests, delivery status, SLA compliance, and revenue attribution — reviewed weekly with BU Head.


**Key Responsibilities**
 AI\-First Analysis and Insight Generation
   

  

* Default to AI augmentation for every analytical task: data pulls, pattern identification, RCA structuring, QBR narrative drafting, and BRD first drafts
* Build and maintain AI\-powered workflows using ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, or equivalent — document every workflow so the team can replicate it, not just you
* Use AI agents to surface new insights from existing client data: anomaly detection, ITC trend analysis, reconciliation failure pattern identification, and upsell signal mining
* Measure AI leverage monthly: what percentage of team output is AI\-augmented vs. manual — target moves up every quarter, not sideways


 Team Leadership — Data BAs and Field BAs
   

  

* Manage and develop the data BA team (Ranjith's team): structured 1:1s, performance reviews, technical upskilling in SQL, dashboard tools, and AI workflows
* Manage and develop the field BA team: output quality reviews, client observation structuring, and ensuring field findings translate into actionable product inputs within 5 business days
* Set a clear quality bar for every output type — QBR deck, RCA document, BRD, dashboard — and hold the team to it without doing the work yourself
* Run continuous recruitment for the BA bench: own the JD, screen applications, design the interview loop, and manage the onboarding ramp for every new BA hire


 Automation BRDs
   

  

* Author automation BRDs for engineering: reconciliation logic, validation rules, data transformation workflows, and exception handling — specific enough that engineering can build without a PM translation layer
* Identify automation opportunities proactively — anywhere the team is doing something manually more than twice a week, evaluate whether it should be a BRD
* Maintain a live automation backlog: prioritised, with business justification, effort estimates from engineering, and expected impact on client outcomes
* Own automation delivery from BRD to UAT: you wrote it, you verify it works


 Dashboard Ownership
   

  

* Build and maintain dashboards in Tableau, Power BI, or equivalent: client health scores, issue resolution tracking, SLA compliance, customisation pipeline, and QBR trend data
* Dashboards are not maintenance tasks — they are decision tools. Every dashboard you build must answer a specific question for a specific audience
* Automate dashboard refresh where possible; reduce manual data preparation to zero on recurring dashboards
* Present dashboard insights at weekly internal reviews and monthly BU Head reviews — proactive, not reactive


 Enterprise Client Management and Push Back
   

  

* Run QBRs for the BU's enterprise accounts: own the data pack, the trend narrative, and the action items — not just the slides
* Manage enterprise client escalations that reach the Senior BA layer: investigate, respond within SLA, and close the loop in writing
* Push back on client requests that fall outside scope, roadmap, or delivery capacity — clearly, with evidence, without damaging the relationship
* Protect delivery timelines against scope creep: every new client request gets triaged, estimated, and formally accepted or declined — no informal commitments


 Client Upselling Through Documentation
   

  

* Build and maintain a upsell documentation library: ROI reports by client segment, value realisation summaries, customisation case studies, and expansion proposal templates
* Produce value reports for top\-25 accounts quarterly: what Finkraft has delivered, in numbers, against what was promised
* Identify expansion signals in client data and QBR conversations; document them with specificity and hand off to Sales with context — not just a name and a note
* Track upsell pipeline contribution from the BA layer: how many qualified opportunities identified, how many converted, what revenue attributed


 Customisation Pipeline Ownership
   

  

* Own the full customisation pipeline: intake, scoping, prioritisation, delivery tracking, and client communication
* Set quarterly customisation targets with the BU Head: number of customisations delivered, average delivery time, SLA compliance rate, and revenue attributed
